bridges.name: Syaphru Besi I / Trishuli footbridge
limitations: Exact failure time is unknown.
Review squares are annotations, not surveyed damage boundaries.
Manual satellite review does not establish surrounding route passability.
No precision image coregistration or automated damage model was used.

Retrospective, manually inspected demonstration examples. Baseline is three years earlier and does not alone date the loss to the 2026 event. The July 2025 Rasuwa flood is an intervening event; its impact on these exact crossings is unverified. No model accuracy claim. Pixel windows are georeferenced, but no precision image coregistration was performed.
